First class $10 · Mats and blocks included

How much time do you have today?

    Most people don’t quit yoga because it’s hard. They quit because it doesn’t fit their week.

    • Classes at times nobody can make

    • Routines built for people with free mornings

    • Feeling behind after missing two weeks

    Morrow is built around real schedules: short classes, late classes, and no guilt when you come back after a break.

    Pick by how you feel, not by level.

    60min

    Slow

    Long holds, deep stretches, a lot of breathing. For tired bodies and busy heads.

    45min

    Strong

    Flow that makes you sweat. Builds strength without jumping around.

    30min

    Quick

    Lunch-break class. In, stretch, out, back to work.

    50min

    Night

    Candlelight, slow music, the last class of the day at 8:30 pm. Sleep better after.

    Something on every day.

    Your first class, step by step.

    1. Book online

      Pick any class marked Good for first time.

    2. Come 10 minutes early

      We’ll show you around and ask about any injuries.

    3. Bring nothing

      Mats, blocks, towels and water are here.

    4. Stay after

      Tea and a quick chat about which class to try next.
